---
title: "Analyzing US Census Data"
author: "Zheyre Tolliver"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE,
  progress_bar = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
income_tx |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    labels = scales::label_dollar(),
    na.value = "gray80"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by Texas County, 2020",
    subtitle = "American Community Survey 5-year estimates (2016 to 2020)",
    fill = "Median income",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau via tidycensus"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    "B15003_022",
    "B15003_023",
    "B15003_024",
    "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```
```{r}
#| fig-height: 9
edu_state |>
filter(variable != "B15003_001") |>
summarize(
bachelors_plus = sum(estimate),
total = first(summary_est),
.by = NAME
) |>
mutate(pct_bachelors = 100 * bachelors_plus / total) |>
ggplot(aes(x = pct_bachelors, y = reorder(NAME, pct_bachelors))) +
geom_col(fill = "mediumpurple") +
labs(
title = "Adults with at Least a Bachelor's Degree, 2020",
subtitle = "Share of adults 25 and older, by state",
x = "Percent with a bachelor's degree or higher",
y = NULL,
caption = "Source: ACS 5-year estimates via tidycensus"
) +
theme_minimal() +
theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
```
